reviews.text: Serious, honest and professional person, always available, animal lover
A highly experienced doctor, a very helpful professional and animal lover.

He killed my dog.
He didn't recognize acute pancreatitis and ignored the symptoms of chronic pancreatitis for years, dismissing me every time with "I have a stomach ache," despite repeatedly requesting further tests, pointing out numerous symptoms, and even suggesting a diagnosis (I'd told him it could be pancreatitis, but he told me it absolutely wasn't possible). He treated my dog ​​(when I brought her to him, her blood tests were excellent, but still, some results clearly suggested pancreatitis) with an antibiotic, and it made things worse. In two weeks, I took her to him 6 TIMES. I trusted him because he'd already operated on her in the past and saved her. Exhausted by the lack of answers and my dog's worsening condition, I took her to the veterinary clinic at the university. The diagnosis was hemorrhagic necrotic pancreatitis. On Wednesday, he gave her an anti-inflammatory and sent me back to Monday. But she never made it to Monday...on Friday, April 25, 2025, my dog ​​died in the hospital from severe sepsis. We tried everything, even transfusions.
She should be ashamed.
She will carry my Kira's death on her conscience FOREVER.

If you're thinking about it, forget it, go elsewhere. Lucio Mele is a *basic* veterinarian, meaning he's competent in routine situations, not specialized problems. Yet he persists in dispensing directions on nutrition, behavior, reproduction... specialized fields he knows nothing about, just like many of his pet owners and clients, and in fact, he messes things up. The greatest quality a doctor (veterinarian or otherwise) must have is humility, the humility to say, "I don't know what's going on," "It's beyond my expertise." Lucio Mele lacks this quality, and this serious lack of it, combined with the wrong therapy he recommended, today caused the death of a dog I knew. In this specific case, Mele not only failed to identify the condition (which was common among his former patients, precisely because of some of his nutritional beliefs), but actually confidently ruled it out. He began the wrong treatment for another condition (refusing to undergo the necessary diagnostic tests, despite the owners' insistent demands), which proved detrimental to the dog's condition. He failed to identify the severity of the situation (he sent a dog home for a week that wouldn't eat or drink), and he didn't have the honesty to admit he had no solution and needed to contact a specialist.
Despite the care provided by other specialists in the dog's final 48 hours of life, there was nothing that could be done. Mele's ravings had wasted precious time, and the point of no return had now been passed. A doctor who can't admit his own limitations ends up doing harm. Today, it happened. Today, Mele struck, and the horrible thing is that knowing him, he will never admit his responsibility. Protect your pets, take them to competent professionals, and for those who will trust his kind ways, best wishes!

I took my cat Salem to Dr. Lucio and I couldn't have made a better choice! Besides being a wonderful person, he's an extremely patient and competent veterinarian. I was very scared, but he managed to reassure me with his professionalism and reassuring manner. Salem can be a bit aggressive when he's scared, but the doctor was able to handle him with great sensitivity and experience. Thanks to his care, Salem is now doing great! I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian.

A very competent and professional doctor... He took care of both my furry friends with patience and kindness... He is always available for a consultation or advice... I recommend him to anyone who loves their puppies

!!!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!
Dr. Lucio Mele is the one to whom this beautiful cat owes his life... he came to him with numerous bladder stones and a certain risk of kidney failure. The difficulty with this cat is his enormous weight and advanced age, so everyone advised against surgery. So, here we come to the wonderful doctor, who, by warning me of the real risks of the situation, gave me strength and performed the operation perfectly on my little one. He recommended the right precautions for a healthy and successful recovery. In addition to his skill and professionalism, I recommend him both for his compassionate approach to my cat, which shows his great love for animals, and for me, for whom he always had a kind word of comfort. To be fair, he was also quite economical, so what can I say other than a big thank you?

Dr. Lucio Mele has always been competent, sensitive, and attentive with my cats.
Years ago, I brought a dying kitten to him, and he saved her.
When we later had this same kitten spayed, he took great care to explain to us exactly how to care for her after the surgery.
He's also always attentive to our other cat; now that our third has arrived, she's entrusted to him with our complete trust.
Dr. Mele is an exceptional veterinarian and a delightful person.
A very attentive and scrupulous doctor who practices this profession with great love and seriousness. I recommend him to you with all my heart.
We have known each other for 9 years, I have 4 Pitbulls and I have always gotten along well, my first dog is literally in love with the doctor

Dr. Lucio Mele is clearly incompetent. After performing a routine spay on our cat, he didn't even bother to put a collar on her to prevent her from touching the wound. The stitches burst open, and the wound worsened, even causing the cat to vomit.
The doctor didn't understand anything, downplaying the problem and telling us to bring her in the next day, leaving her with the wound open for the entire day. Naturally, we immediately went to the emergency vet, who resolved everything, and they were also outraged by the doctor's incompetence.
A very professional and helpful doctor. He loves his job and his little four-legged friends...highly recommended!
